title: Figure 15: Balanced homodyne detector with a local oscillator (photodiodes x and y)
description: Schematic of two photodiodes labeled "Photodiode x" and "Photodiode y" with outputs F(x) and F(y), a point P between them, and local oscillator (LO) beams entering from below with horizontal lines marked "wavefronts." Caption reads "Figure 15. Balanced Homodyne Detector with a Local Oscillator. (courtesy of P. Marecki)" and notes the LO electric field at x is reversed relative to that at y. Equations (15) and (16) follow.
